item.title: United’s new A321XLR is packed with tech, and it’s about to take on new transatlantic routes
item.description: I toured United’s new high-tech A321XLR, checking out its new Polaris and Premium Plus cabins, 4K OLED screens, Starlink Wi-Fi, and a clever twist on Economy Plus seats.
